purpose: After the livestream: transcript into Knowledge, summary, deck PDF, the summary mail to that night's QR sign-ups (with a prominent newsletter button), hand-off to Atrin, and Martin's feedback at a slot from Tempo.

inputs.what: YouTube VOD of tonight (list-channel → newest stream)
subscribers who signed up tonight via the end-screen QR

steps.do: Wait for the VOD (transcribe_list_channel), then transcribe_video {url, store:true}: transcript and its Knowledge document in one call (audio deleted after). Never paste transcript text into a document yourself
Write the summary (from transcribe_read) in Knowledge 'Meetup transcripts', linked to the transcript document that transcribe_video stored; remember key lessons in the brain
Listmonk campaign to tonight's QR sign-ups: summary + PDF link + prominent 'join the newsletter feed' button (→ Mautic onboarding)
Hand-off note to Atrin (transcript + summary ids) for video
Ask Tempo for Martin's free slot; at the slot ask Martin: slides well received? content up to par?
Store Martin's feedback in the brain; RunReport lessons

done_when: campaign sent to tonight's sign-ups or 0 sign-ups recorded
Martin's feedback recorded or asked twice

approvals.notes: Releasing the summary newsletter is the only message to individuals Henry sends.
